hero.sub: Search, summarize, and locate any moment. Jockey turns your video library into a teammate who has seen everything.
hero.chip_query: when does the keeper save the penalty?
hero.h1_v2: See the unseen in every video.
hero.sub_v2: Search, chat with, and segment your footage in natural language. State-of-the-art video understanding turns hours of raw video into searchable, answerable, AI-ready moments.

search.title: Search
search.body: Drag a video into chat and ask anything. Get answers grounded in the timeline.

summarize.title: Summarize
summarize.body: One-paragraph or chapter-by-chapter summaries of any video in your library.

find.title: Find the moment
find.body: Natural-language search across your whole library. Jockey jumps straight to the second.

step1.title: Upload videos
step1.body: Drop in MP4s or paste a link. Jockey indexes the visuals, audio, and transcript.

step2.title: Ask in plain words
step2.body: Type a question or paste a transcript snippet. No filters, no SQL.

step3.title: Jump to the moment
step3.body: Click a match to seek the player to the exact second. Verify in one click.

capabilities.sub: Experience semantic search and video-to-text capabilities that surpass anything you've tried before — video-native AI makes all the difference.
capabilities.search_body: Find specific moments within your videos by describing the scene in natural language.
capabilities.analyze_body: Generate text from videos — summary, chapters, highlights and more.
capabilities.segment_body: Partition videos into labeled, time-stamped chapters you can reuse downstream.

capability_detail.search_title: Find any scene in natural language.
capability_detail.search_body: Fast, precise, context-aware results that truly understand what you're looking for. Search across speech, text, audio and visuals to explore your video in every dimension.
capability_detail.analyze_body: Create instant text formats like Q&As, hashtags, and summaries. Generate reports or get domain-specific analysis to answer your deepest questions.
capability_detail.segment_body: Build features like semantic search and domain classification with embeddings that capture nuance — and make the most of all your data.

models.qddetr_blurb: Trained SG-DETR span head over frozen InternVideo2 features for moment retrieval and highlights.

demo_fixture.qa1_q: What happens at the end of the video?
demo_fixture.qa1_a: The match finishes at the final whistle (1:11) and the winning side lifts the trophy as confetti falls over the pitch (1:22).
demo_fixture.qa2_a: Yes — a single goal is scored into the top corner at 0:42, immediately followed by the players' celebration at 0:49.
demo_fixture.qa3_a: After the goal the camera cuts to the stands where the crowd roars and fans celebrate (0:58).
